info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Initiation Report API
info.description: The Payment Initiation Report API provides access to detailed reporting on file payments initiated through the Open Banking Payment Initiation Service (PISP). This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive reports based on specific payment parameters. Typical consumers include financial institutions and payment service providers looking to audit, analyze, or present data regarding payment transactions. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate valuable reporting features into their applications, thereby enhancing transparency and decision-making related to payment activities.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the report file associated with the specified payment ID, PAY-300045. The report contains detailed information about the transaction and can be used for auditing and documentation purposes.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the report file associated with the payment ID PAY-300045. This request targets the specific file generated for this payment, allowing clients to access relevant financial documentation.

GetReportFileForPayment300045Request.description: This schema represents the JSON body format expected for a request to retrieve a report file related to file payments. The content is a string that typically contains information about the report request or a unique identifier.
